## DEFAULT\_FONT\_WEIGHT\_COEFFS variable

The coefficients used when the config supplies none.

**Signature:**

```typescript
DEFAULT_FONT_WEIGHT_COEFFS: FontWeightCoefficients
```

## Remarks

A user-supplied map is merged over these rather than replacing them, so a config may retune `bold` alone without restating all nine numeric weights.
